name: embeddings follow the chat provider
note: embedProvider=openai, embedModel=gemini-embedding-001 — with AI_PROVIDER=openai, query embeddings move to OpenAI and no longer match stored gemini-embedding-001 chunk vectors (retrieval silently falls back to BM25)

name: draft goes to POST /v1/responses with JSON mode
note: text.format = json_object (JSON mode, not strict json_schema)

name: draft JSON parsed → pending draft with valid citations + verifier claims
note: status pending, risk high, verify model gpt-5.4-mini

name: verify call uses the verify model
reasoning.effort is sent
note: not sent: GPT-5.5 / 5.6 default to medium effort, GPT-5.4 to none; AI_*_THINKING is ignored for OpenAI

name: max_output_tokens leaves room for reasoning tokens
note: max_output_tokens=2948 (Gemini gets +1536 headroom; OpenAI reasoning tokens count inside this limit)

name: store:false is sent (no 30-day response storage)
note: Responses API stores responses for 30 days unless store:false

name: provider.js PRICES know the account's GPT-5.x models
default OpenAI models exist on this account
note: defaults draft gpt-6.1-sol / verify gpt-6.1-terra / classify gpt-6-luna / embed text-embedding-3-large; AI_*_MODEL must be set (draft.js passes AI_DRAFT_MODEL explicitly, so no fallback chain runs)

name: a reasoning-truncated response (status: incomplete) is reported clearly
note: surfaces as "draft model returned no JSON" — the tokens are still billed and the job retries with the same limit

name: this script's adapter: effort low, +1536 headroom, store:false
